description_en: Controls O&M behaviors through Settings for command control, command approval, protocol control, and access control policy to effectively prevent users from executing high-risk commands or performing misoperations, ensuring O&M security
description_zh: 通过设置命令控制、命令审批、协议控制、访问控制策略等，对运维行为进行管控，有效防止用户进行高危命令操作或误操作，以保障运维安全
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost create-policy --instance-id bastionhost-cn-20p364c1w0g --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --policy-name policytest --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreatePolicy

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host instance for which you want to create a control policy.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
要新建控制策略的堡垒机实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host for which you want to create a control policy.
For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定需创建控制策略所在的堡垒机的地域ID。
地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the control policy. Maximum length: 128 characters
parameters.help_zh: 指定控制策略名称。最大128字符
parameters.name: policy_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the control policy. Maximum length: 500 characters
parameters.help_zh: 控制策略的备注。最大500字符
parameters.name: comment

parameters.help_en:
The priority of the control policy.

Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 1, which indicates the policy priority.
Different control policies can have the same priority. If multiple control policies have the same priority, the most recently created policy has the policy priority. Within a single policy, if the same command is configured in both command control and command approval, the priority from high to low is: reject, allow, and approval
parameters.help_zh:
控制策略的优先级。

优先级可设置范围：1~100。默认值为1，即最高优先级。
不同控制策略可以设置相同的优先级。多个控制策略的优先级相同时，最新创建的策略优先级最高。在一条策略中，若命令控制和命令审批里设置有相同的命令，则优先级从高到低是拒绝、允许、审批
parameters.name: priority
